title: Simple Vanilla Enhanced
body:
![Simple Vanilla Enhanced Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2b1bac04d7f5fa7f32bb4a27ecfc7c13ff3ff0fd.png)

Welcome to Simple Vanilla Enhanced 

This Modpack aims to make vanilla singleplayer better it is mostly for vanilla but a few mods work on multiplayer too.

Want Vanilla Singleplayer but a bit enhanced not too much tho, than this modpack is for you.
Simple Vanilla Enhanced adds features that vanilla should have like better end and nether dimensions.
